newsitem.title: USA: Caliber sees improved Q2 operating results.
newsitem.headline: Caliber sees improved Q2 operating results.

text.p: Caliber System Inc said Tuesday it expects to post improved operating profits for the second quarter, which ended June 21.
The company also said it expects its Viking unit to report a profitable second quarter, excluding about $16 million of transition costs.
Caliber said early indications are that the $85 million charge from the Viking restructuring included in its first quarter results will turn out to be less than it has expected.
Caliber expects to release second quarter earnings during the week of July 14.

The company said its second quarter revenue and profits at its RPS unit are expected to increase about 12 percent over 1996 figures. It also said double-digit growth at the RPS division should continue through 1997.

The company said proceeds from the sale of the former Central Freight Lines, as well as revenue equipment and surplus terminals from the former Coles Express and Spartan Express, are expected to reduce its debt by about $70 million from its current level of $315 million.
The company expects capital spending to be under $135 million for 1997.
